description: What staff with a role may do at the till: discounts, price changes, refunds without a receipt and bonus loyalty points.

fields.description: The staff role these rules are for. Everyone with this role gets these powers at the till.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Leave blank to use these rules on every till. Choose a POS Profile to set different rules for one till; they replace this role's every-till rules there.
fields.label: POS Profile

fields.description: Untick to switch these rules off without deleting them.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Tick to let this role give any discount, with no limit.
fields.label: Allow Any Discount

fields.description: Highest discount this role can give on one item or on the whole sale. 0 means no discount at all.
fields.label: Max Discount %

fields.description: Let this role give a discount on a single item in the sale.
fields.label: Allow Item Discount

fields.description: Let this role give a discount on the whole sale.
fields.label: Allow Discount on the Whole Sale

fields.description: Let this role change an item's price at the till.
fields.label: Allow Price Change at the Till

fields.description: Let this role refund items when the customer has no receipt.
fields.label: Allow Refund Without Receipt

fields.description: Let this role add bonus loyalty points to a customer, for example as an apology.
fields.label: Allow Bonus Loyalty Points

name: POS Role Rule
